{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Re-send failed SMS messages.

The SMS gateway was down for several hours during cycle 1, so some delivery texts
never arrived. The gateway records which messages failed in data/sms_status.json.

This script re-sends each failed message to the same household, with the same
message and details as the original. Households whose message was delivered (or
whose message has no status entry) are never texted. If a failed message has
already been re-sent (an identical message queued after the original), the
household is skipped so nobody is texted twice.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages


def main() -> None:
    outbox = sent_messages()
    status = delivery_status()

    failed = [m for m in outbox if status.get(m.id) == "failed"]

    resent = 0
    skipped = 0
    for original in failed:
        already_resent = any(
            m.household_id == original.household_id
            and m.template_id == original.template_id
            and m.params == original.params
            and m.id > original.id
            for m in outbox
        )
        if already_resent:
            skipped += 1
            print(f"skip {original.id}: household {original.household_id} already re-sent")
            continue
        queue_sms(original.household_id, original.template_id, original.params, now=None)
        resent += 1
        print(f"re-sent {original.id}: queued new text to household {original.household_id}")

    print(f"summary: {len(failed)} failed messages, {skipped} skipped (already re-sent), {resent} re-sent")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
